# Reusable desktop runtime

Imported from the installed basecamp/omarchy 4.0.4 package on 2026-10-20.
Shell/QML, Hyprland defaults and selected desktop helper scripts are included. No installer,
package manager, updater, or system provisioning code is imported.
Legacy plugin IDs are retained for compatibility with the personal plugin set.
NixOS uses the private runtime and host backend, not /usr/share/omarchy.
Local OS-specific adaptations are made in packages/desktop/runtime.nix.
Upstream project: https://github.com/basecamp/omarchy (MIT).
